keepout.command: uv run python -m cubesat.benchmark --mode keepout-report --base data/scenarios/two_failure.json --out data/eval/benchmark --report data/eval/benchmark_results.json
keepout.j2_drag_caveat: Boundedness of the dead-satellite coast holds under linear, unperturbed CW dynamics only; J2 and atmospheric drag would drift the dead satellites further than reported here (GATES.md:27, README.md:89-90).

keepout_binding_comparison.decision_text: keep-out binding in both runs (1852.5 m without, 1322.6 m with, threshold 2000.0 m) but the exclusion improves the worst clearance; policy 5 kept
